question.text: The Binomial option pricing model was developed by:

answer.text: Fisher Black and Myron Scholes in 1973

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook, the Binomial option pricing model was developed by William Sharpe in 1978. It uses a tree of possible prices at equal time steps to value an option. The Trap: Black-Scholes was published in 1973 by Fisher Black and Myron Scholes - that is a different model. The Binomial model is distinct in being iterative and step-based rather than a closed-form formula. Note: Although both models appear in the workbook, only the Binomial attribution to Sharpe in 1978 matches the source for this question.
